title: Burnham urged to crack down on gig economy firms to protect 4m workers

paragraphs.en: Andy Burnham is being urged to protect 4 million gig economy workers by prosecuting companies that use widespread “bogus” self-employment practices to deny people their rights.
paragraphs.zh: 安德·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）被呼吁起诉那些普遍采用“虚假”自雇做法以剥夺人们权利的零工经济公司，从而保护400万零工经济从业者。

paragraphs.en: As the prime minister fleshes out his agenda, the Fabian Society and the Joseph Rowntree Foundation have warned that millions of workers are missing out on key statutory rights including parental leave, redundancy pay and protection against unfair dismissal.
paragraphs.zh: 在首相充实其施政议程之际，费边社（Fabian Society）和约瑟夫·朗特里基金会（Joseph Rowntree Foundation）警告称，数百万工人正失去关键的法定权利，包括育儿假、遣散费和免受不公平解雇的保护。

paragraphs.en: Publishing a joint report calling on Burnham to take action, the Labour-linked thinktank and the anti-poverty charity said changes were essential to make work pay amid the cost of living crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 这份与工党有联系的智库和这家反贫困慈善机构联合发布报告，呼吁伯纳姆采取行动。它们表示，在生活成本危机中，改革对于“让工作有回报”至关重要。

paragraphs.en: The report calls on the government’s Fair Work Agency – launched in April as a powerful watchdog for workers’ rights – to use its civil proceedings powers to prosecute companies suspected of engaging in “widespread bogus self-employment”.
paragraphs.zh: 报告呼吁政府于今年4月成立的“公平工作局”（Fair Work Agency）——一个为工人权利把关的有力监督机构——利用其民事诉讼权力，起诉涉嫌从事“大规模虚假自雇”的公司。

paragraphs.en: It also urges ministers to push ahead with changes to employment law to combat longstanding misuse of the system.
paragraphs.zh: 报告还敦促部长们推进就业法改革，以遏制长期存在的制度滥用问题。

paragraphs.en: Britain’s employment laws are unusual among leading economies for including three classifications of employment status. An employee has the most rights and responsibilities, while a self-employed person has limited protections but fewer obligations. There is also an intermediate “worker”, or “limb (b)” status, with fewer rights and obligations than a full employee.
paragraphs.zh: 在主要经济体中，英国的就业法因包含三种就业身份分类而显得特殊。正式雇员（employee）享有的权利和承担的责任最多，自雇人士（self-employed）享有的保护有限，但义务也较少。此外还有一种介于两者之间的“劳动者”（worker）身份，即“limb (b)”身份，其权利和义务都少于正式雇员。

paragraphs.en: According to the report, as many as 4 million workers – including hairdressers, personal trainers, delivery workers and drivers for gig economy platforms – work in this gap. Experts say many have been hired by gig economy companies in this way to avoid granting them employment rights.
paragraphs.zh: 报告称，多达400万工人——包括美发师、私人教练、配送员以及零工经济平台的司机——正处在这一制度空档中工作。专家表示，许多人是被零工经济公司以这种方式雇佣的，目的是规避赋予他们就业权利。

paragraphs.en: Labour had promised to create a single “worker” status for all but the genuinely self-employed, before rowing back on the plan to fend off Conservative attacks on its approach to business before the 2024 general election.
paragraphs.zh: 工党此前曾承诺，除了真正的自雇人士外，为所有人设立统一的“劳动者”身份，但在2024年大选前，为抵御保守党对其商业方针的抨击，又收回了这一计划。
